limitations: Archive downloaded and inspected (1.2 GB, 2405 JPEGs, 1640x1232), but the documented layout (4 plants side by side; 1 and 3 watered, 2 and 4 stressed) does not hold in these frames: each frame shows only about 1-2 plants and consecutive frames cycle through different camera positions/heights, so no frame-to-plant-position mapping could be established.
Only 2 capture dates (2020-10-18 and 2020-10-19) are present, so a hold-out-by-last-30%-of-dates split is impossible and there is no days-since-start trend to report.
Images are lit by pink/red LED grow lights, so RGB and excess-green indices are not comparable to daylight field imagery.

Without verifiable per-plant labels, any watered-vs-stressed classifier would be trained on guessed labels; no model was trained and no accuracy is reported. No wilting_*.jpg or healthy_zen_*.jpg images were produced because no crop can be honestly labelled as drought-stressed.
Other trials (Trial001_1,2,4,5, Trial002, Trial003) were not downloaded and might have a usable layout; not verified.
